name: -10 AN Fitting 90 Degree Male to Male Flare Union
title: -10 AN Fitting 90 Degree Male to Male Flare Union
description:
The -10 AN Fitting 90 Degree Male to Male Flare Union is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings 90 Degree Male to Male Union Adapters are precision CNC-machined to provide a compact 90-degree connection between female AN fittings, improving hose routing and clearance in tight engine bays. Designed with true 37-degree AN flare seats on both ends, these adapters deliver a secure, leak-free seal for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, brake, and power steering systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for high velocity in tight engine bays.
